title: fix: don't fail Biome CI step when every changed file is ignored
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `--no-errors-on-unmatched` to the "Run Biome on changed files" step in `ci-pull-request-checks.yml`
- Before: a PR that only touches files ignored by `biome.json`, such as the generated `enter.pollinations.ai/worker-bindings.d.ts`, fails with "No files were processed" (exit 123), which also fails the required "Check formatting and linting" check. Seen on #16236
- Real lint errors still fail the step; the flag only silences the empty-match error

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Nothing to lint, nothing to fix
gist.blurb: An empty Biome file list no longer trips the required CI check. Actual lint errors still get the usual attention.
gist.summary: The Biome CI step adds `--no-errors-on-unmatched` so PRs changing only ignored files, such as generated `enter.pollinations.ai/worker-bindings.d.ts`, avoid the empty-match exit 123 while real lint errors still fail.
gist.impact: Contributors can pass the required formatting and linting check when Biome has no changed files to process, without weakening checks on files it does inspect.

Polli, wearing a tiny maintainer cap, calmly points the monitor robot toward a separate lint error that still needs fixing; code-plants soften the workspace.
